data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 shares mechanism with SRC_005: both detect correlated errors — SRC_001 uses inter-rater correlation to reveal shared bias in aggregation, and SRC_005 uses error-cluster alignment with the checklist's surface proxies to reveal mere compliance. The shared mechanism is 'error-correlation reveals the absence of independent causal capture'; it is refuted if either detector's signal can be fully replicated without measuring any form of error correlation, e.g., by mean-accuracy differences alone.
